The workers are here bright and early with their noise but and my stand alone sleep machine just doesn't cut it. I put my air buds in and go back to sleep because this app blocks out everything when you choose the right settings. The only reason for 3 stars is that I don't appreciate being woken up by an app that's supposed to help you sleep, by warning that my volume maybe too loud. And repeatedly! Could you tell me that one time when I first start it up & not when I've had enough time to fall asleep?? From there, I am able to take on responsibility for my own hearing. Moreover, multiple warnings are pretty upsetting, especially when I've gone in to adjust the volume already. Certain scenarios require louder volumes. This is as infuriating as when my airbuds signal when they're about to turn off, which also wakes me up! All of these bells and whistles cause broken sleep, defeating the purpose. One of my top 5 favorite apps!. I never write reviews but I had to for this!! We started using this app when we had our 2nd baby. There was a great white noise option on his bassinet that helped him go to sleep and stay that way. Then one day we traveled without the bassinet and had the worst night ever! Baby would not sleep!!!! I became a little desperate and bought all the $$$ sound machines on the market to take if we traveled again. None had the same white noise. They all had an option but none were the same “blend of sounds” and somehow this kid knew!

That’s when I thought to look at apps. I found this one and loved it from the start!! I was able to sit next to the bassinet while it had the white noise playing and basically “tune” the app to sound exactly the same by trying different combos of rain, water falls, etc. It was magic! Finally we all got to sleep at grandmas house when we visit!! 

A few months later, we moved baby out of our room and out of the bassinet to a crib. We were able to transition him to another sound machine that stays in his room but hubby & I were hooked and kept using the app in our room. 2.5 years later and we still use it every night. I no longer spend any time laying awake trying to fall asleep. I swear I’m out moments after my head hits the pillow. If I wake up to go to the bathroom, I’m back asleep as soon as I get back to the bed! I also think I sleep deeper and feel more rested. My hubby also downloaded the app and uses it whenever he travels for work! We all just used it a few weeks ago on our 7 night cruise. 

Seriously one of the best and most useful apps I’ve ever downloaded!!

Developer has not updated in almost 18 months now and is unresponsive to feedback. 

For these items I deducted 2 stars.

Suggestions/Complaints:

• The UI is very confusing, it needs to be simplified. Some of the settings should be in a Settings panel and the App currently has none. The mix panel seems to appear and disappear for mysterious reasons, perhaps because the App needs to updated for iOS 10.
• App appears to assume all sleep activity is preplanned, which is ridiculous, if I take an impromptu nap in the afternoon, it takes minutes for me to trick the App into engaging.
• Some of the clock screens are nice, but most are mediocre or just silly. The developer can do much better, trust me, I used to do UI work for a living.
• Six weeks or so ago I asked the developer to consider a tvOS version (and so far no response), I encourage others to do the same. If I need to nap in the family room, I'd like my Apple TV to handle the sound and display.

All that being said, this seems to be the best or a top sleep App in the store. In many ways, this App has what the Bedtime feature of the Clock App needs, and vice versa (hint to developers and Apple).
